checks.claim: A pool skimmer pulls water and floating debris from the surface into a basket.
checks.why: The pump's suction draws surface water through the skimmer opening and the basket traps the floating debris.

sources.title: Solved! What Is a Pool Skimmer? (Bob Vila)
Pool & Spa Skimmers Explained (Bath and Spa Parts)

checks.claim: A pool's main drain sits at the deepest point of the floor.
checks.why: Manufacturers specify installing the main drain at the deepest point of the pool.

checks.claim: A sand filter is cleaned by backwashing: the flow is reversed and the dirt goes to waste.
checks.why: Backwashing sends water up through the sand bed and out the waste line, carrying the trapped dirt.

sources.title: How a pool sand filter works (Pooldial)
How to backwash a sand filter (Swim University)

checks.claim: Chlorine kills the algae that turns pool water green.
checks.why: Green algae is not chlorine resistant; shocking with chlorine kills it.
